{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) and recent prices show downward momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% in next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is positive (e.g., +0.50) and true prices are trending lower.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; lag corrections by 1-2 periods for smoother transitions.",
    "If true price drops below 60% of 30-day forecast, apply a downward correction of 10-20% to next forecast.",
    "When sentiment is neutral and price is trending upward, slightly reduce forecast to avoid overestimating momentum."
  ]
}
